_readme: Global site settings. Empty strings or values starting with 'TODO' are treated as NOT SET: the UI hides them or shows a 'link pending' state. Platform keys must exist in js/platforms.js (add a new platform there once, then just paste its URL here).
_stats: Headline stats supplied by Justin on 2026-10-01 ('11 albums, 5 EPs and 20 singles released in less than 13 months'). Shown on Home + About. Remove or edit here; an empty list hides the strip.
_featuredReleaseId: Leave empty to feature the newest release automatically, or put a release id from releases.json.

platforms.appleMusic: TODO: add Apple Music artist URL (note: Apple's 'Prismatic Wave' artist page 1795750961 also lists an EP by a different label, so confirm with Justin first)
platforms.youtubeMusic: TODO: add YouTube Music channel URL

contact._email: PLACEHOLDER — this is the business email on record for Justin; confirm it is the right public contact for Prismatic Wave, then set emailConfirmed to true (removes the 'to be confirmed' badge).
contact.subject: Prismatic Wave enquiry
contact.note: Bookings, sync & licensing, collaborations and press.

brand._readme: Brand assets. Image objects {base, widths, width, height, alt} point at optimised files base-<width>.{avif,webp,jpg} made by tools/optimise-brand.py from Justin's originals (kept untouched in assets/brand/source/). A plain path string also works for any image field.
brand._logo: TYPOGRAPHIC PLACEHOLDER: there is no dedicated Prismatic Wave logo yet. Replace this SVG (same name) or point this field at the real logo.
brand._ahmpLogo: AHMP monogram + equaliser mark, cropped from Justin's AHMP poster (3547.jpg) with a transparent background. Designed for dark backgrounds. assets/brand/logo-ahmp.svg is the older typographic placeholder.

heroImage.alt: AlgoRythm Hybrid Music Production poster: a glowing blue neural-network brain over a circuit board, chrome AlgoRythm wordmark, waveform and the AHMP mark, with the tagline AI + Human • Code + Soul, Create Without Limits

studioPhoto.alt: Justin Erasmus in his studio at a laptop, surrounded by holographic 'Algorithmic Hybrid Engine' panels, neon-lit speakers and a pad controller

seo.description: Prismatic Wave is the hybrid music project of South African producer Justin Erasmus, made through AlgoRythm Hybrid Music Production (AHMP). Human creativity × AI × Music × Technology. Listen on Spotify and Suno.
seo.keywords: Prismatic Wave, hybrid music producer, AI-assisted music, AlgoRythm Hybrid Music Production, AHMP, Justin Erasmus, South Africa

player._sourcePriority: When a track has several sources the first available one is used. 'audio' = self-hosted audioUrl (full controls).
player._spotifyIframeApi: true = use Spotify's official iFrame API for play/pause/seek/progress (needs 'unsafe-eval' + https://embed-cdn.spotifycdn.com in the CSP). false = plain Spotify embed only (listener presses play inside it) and you can remove those two CSP entries.
